description: SFLOW channel 10 m x 2 m (walls at the sides) over a sand mound on the axis, discharge 0.6 m3/s, 0.5 m deep, potential flow start (I 11 1), no bed smoothing (A 209 0), MPM, default Exner (S 31 2, first-order upwind): the upwind face flux of S 31 2 by flux splitting (sediment_fou), the bed stays symmetric about the axis (1e-7 m) and is the same on 1 and 2 ranks (1e-12 m). Before patch SFLOW Sediment Check/0003 the face took the whole flux of one of its two cells by the sign of a face velocity of round-off size (asymmetry and rank dependence of 1 % of the bed change). I 11 1: the outflow of the Laplace problem is the discharge (patch 0001; before, the 2D start velocities were +-6.6 m/s).
